svg.title: orq: the orchestration circuit
svg.desc: The owner invokes the skill and decides. The orchestrator does not build: it dispatches briefs to three lanes, each in its own worktree, and verifies the receipts that come up. The hook watches every lane and warns the orchestrator. Only the orchestrator, with a permit, merges to master. Below, the life of a lane in five steps: brief, builds, 4 suites, Codex review, receipt.
svg.text: merge · only the orchestrator, with a permit
